# Kamayega Bharat - Local Employment & Talent Marketplace
**Developer:** Sourav Bagchi

> A high-performance, dual-sided job platform built to connect local talent with verified employers in India, featuring real-time data synchronization and professional verification.

## Core Functionality
* [Job Search & Discovery](https://kamayegabharat.github.io/Kamayega-Bharat/profile.html) - Search and filter local jobs.
* [Employer Dashboard](https://kamayegabharat.github.io/Kamayega-Bharat/employer.html) - Post vacancies and search talent.
* [User Authentication](https://kamayegabharat.github.io/Kamayega-Bharat/login.html) - Secure Google and Email login.

## User Roles & Workflows

### 1. Job Seeker
- **Discovery:** [Search Jobs](https://kamayegabharat.github.io/Kamayega-Bharat/profile.html) by role, city, and salary.
- **Verification:** Access to "Golden Frame" verified company postings.
- **Portfolio:** Manage [Skills and Resume](https://kamayegabharat.github.io/Kamayega-Bharat/profile.html) links.
- **Tracking:** Real-time application status monitoring.

### 2. Employer
- **Talent Acquisition:** [Worker Database](https://kamayegabharat.github.io/Kamayega-Bharat/employer.html) search by specific skills.
- **Job Management:** Create, track, and delete job vacancies.
- **Company Verification:** Submit GST/License details for the "Golden Frame" status.

## Technical Specifications
- **Frontend:** [index.html](https://kamayegabharat.github.io/Kamayega-Bharat/index.html) - Responsive HTML5/CSS3.
- **Backend:** Firebase Authentication and Firestore Real-time Database.
- **Security:** reCAPTCHA V3 protection.

## Project Mission
To empower the Indian workforce by providing a fast, secure, and transparent bridge between skill and opportunity.
